caption:
You life is shaped by habits 

#badhabits #habit #healthybodyhealthymind #wellnessjourney #usahealth
transcript: Most people believe their life is shaped by big moments and dramatic decisions, but the truth is quieter than that. Your life is shaped by habits. Nearly everything you do each day happens without thinking. This is why people feel stuck. They want change, but repeat the same patterns every morning. Good habits feel difficult to build, but gentle to live with. Bad habits feel easy at first, but become heavy with time. Change does not hurt because you are weak. It hurts because your body has been trained. Some habits are learned in a second. Touch a hot stove once, and your body remembers forever. Other habits take weeks or months, but all habits are formed the same way. Repetition without exception. First you decide clearly. Then you see yourself already living this way, not some day. Now, if you struggle with food, do not fight desire, change the environment, eat until the edge is gone, then remove the food. When food disappears, appetite fades. Craving often exists only because something is present. This is how habits are built, not through force, but through structure. Choose one habit, practice it daily. If you fall, begin again without punishment. Over time, it becomes easier to stay aligned than to return to the old way. Do not try to change your whole life. Choose one habit that would help you most right now. If you feel called to practice this gently, the 30-day healing journey was created. For this purpose, you can find it in the link on my profile. One small step each day, guided, quiet and steady. There is no pressure, only an invitation to begin.
